effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): Place it face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand Main Phase Quick Effect moves the handler face-up to an open Spell & Trap Zone and trapifies it.

effects.printed_clause: While treated as a Continuous Trap: Add 1 Gravinity Spell or Trap from your Deck to your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect in the Spell & Trap Zone requires current Trap type and searches/confirms a setcoded Gravinity Spell/Trap.

official_references.matched_structure: Archetype card search from Continuous-Trap state.

effects.printed_clause: While treated as a Continuous Trap: Move this card to another column.
effects.lua_implementation: A separate Quick Effect chooses an empty own Spell & Trap Zone and moves the handler.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Gravinity Pulse once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The three effects use id/id+100/id+200 hard once-per-turn keys.

effects.printed_clause: Support implementation for Spell & Trap Zone Synchro material.
effects.lua_implementation: The extra Synchro material helper now returns true only for destination code Gravinity Lapsix or Gravinity Galaxix.

official_references.matched_structure: Destination predicate for extra Synchro material.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the former archetype-wide predicate silently granted permission to unrelated Gravinity Synchros.

coverage_override.reason: Five records cover hand placement, Spell/Trap search choice, column movement choice, per-effect HOPT, and destination-scoped extra-material support.
